headline: World Cup 2026: Argentina and England to clash in blockbuster semi-final
summary: Lionel Messi will face England for the first time in his career as Argentina seeks back-to-back titles, while France and Spain battle for the other spot in the final.
details: The FIFA World Cup 2026 has reached its semi-final stage, featuring a high-stakes showdown between holders Argentina and England. Argentina secured their spot after defeating Switzerland in extra time, with goals from Julian Alvarez and Lautaro Martinez.

Lionel Messi will make his 206th international appearance, marking the first time he has ever faced England. Argentina aims to become the first team to win consecutive World Cups since Brazil in 1962.

England, led by Jude Bellingham and Harry Kane, reached the semi-finals for only the fourth time in their history after a 2-1 extra-time victory over Norway. Bellingham scored both goals to secure the win.

In the other semi-final, France and Spain will face off in Arlington. This is a repeat of their Euro 2024 semi-final, where Spain won 2-1. France's Kylian Mbappe has been in exceptional form, scoring eight goals so far.

The winners of these two matches will advance to the final on July 19 at the MetLife Stadium near New York City. The tournament's draw was designed to ensure the four highest-ranked nations were kept apart until the semi-finals.

headline_marked: 97mm rain in 24h: [[Dhaka faces more rain]] as waterlogging persists
headline: 97mm rain in 24h: Dhaka faces more rain as waterlogging persists
summary: The Bangladesh Meteorological Department records heavy rainfall in the capital, with forecasts predicting continued rain or thunderstorms today.
details: The Bangladesh Meteorological Department (BMD) has recorded 97 mm of rainfall in Dhaka and surrounding areas over the last 24 hours.
The BMD forecast for Monday, July 13, predicts continued rain or thunderstorms in the capital and its adjacent areas for the next six hours.
According to the forecast, the sky will remain mostly cloudy, with winds blowing from the south or southwest at 10 to 15 km/h.
As of 6 AM today, Dhaka's temperature was 27.4 degrees Celsius with a relative humidity of 97 percent.
Yesterday's maximum temperature in the capital was 28.4 degrees Celsius, while today's minimum temperature was recorded at 25.6 degrees Celsius.
The heavy rainfall has led to significant waterlogging in various parts of the city, causing widespread distress for residents and commuters.
